title: The King in Yellow (item)
wikitext:
[[Image:TheKingInYellow.png|right|160px]]
'''The King in Yellow''' is a [[unique item]].  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game.

==Card info==
'''Type''': [[Tome]]

'''Movement''': Exhaust and spend 2 [[movement]] points to make a [[Lore check|Lore (-2) check]].  If you pass, gain 4 [[Clue token]]s, lose 1 [[Sanity]] and discard The King in Yellow.  If you fail nothing happens.

'''Price''': $2
